replays.title: 10 October 2025: USDe at $0.65 on Binance
replays.story: Crash of 10 October 2025: on the Binance order book, USDe falls to $0.65 for about forty minutes, while on-chain it stays close to $1. Binance valued this collateral with ITS own price: positions were liquidated there. What would position A have lived through?

params.name: horizon_days
params.why: Decision horizon of a risk on-call shift; the framing note lists it as an open question for the mentors (24 h or 7 days).

params.name: liquidation_repaid_fraction
params.why: The Morpho docs let a liquidator repay up to 100% of the debt at once; we take that worst case for the borrower.

params.name: liquidator_requires_profit
params.why: A liquidator only acts if the bonus covers the cost of reselling the seized collateral (otherwise: no liquidation, debt at risk for the lenders).

params.name: challenger_delay_hours
params.why: challenge() is permissionless (Steakhouse docs): we assume a bot calls it as soon as the deviation exceeds the threshold (worst case for the borrower).

params.name: exit_pendle_leg
params.note: PT → SY sale simulated at the pinned block by RouterStatic.swapExactPtForSyStatic (Pendle), at several sizes.

params.name: stressed_pool_scaling
params.value: selling Q in a pool k times smaller ≈ selling Q/k in the current pool
params.why: First-order approximation valid for an AMM; a pool that does not exist yet cannot be simulated on-chain.

params.name: second_leg_cost_rate
params.why: sUSDe/USDe → USDC conversion to repay the debt: pools not discovered, fees of a stable pool in the order of a few basis points (not measured).

params.name: unwind_gas_units
params.why: Unwind = flash loan + Morpho repayment + withdrawal + Pendle swap + stable swap; order of magnitude of a few DeFi transactions, not measured.

params.name: carry_pt_implied_apy
params.note: Fixed yield of the PT forgone when exiting (over the horizon).

params.name: carry_borrow_apy
params.note: Borrowing cost saved when exiting (over the horizon).

params.name: pt_extra_amm_discount_under_stress
params.why: The framing note expects "PT ≈ −d% plus the AMM discount"; we cannot calibrate that extra discount, base value 0 and sensitivity displayed.

params.name: custodian_backing_share
params.why: Ethena cites 3 OES providers (Copper, Ceffu, Fireblocks) with no split in our curated layer: an equal split is assumed.

params.name: exchange_exposure_share
params.why: According to Ethena, the exposure to an exchange is limited to the unsettled PnL between two settlement cycles ('Exchange Failure Risk' docs): a small fraction of the reserves.

params.name: usde_depeg_worst_observed
params.note: Every round of the Chainlink USDe/USD feed (phases 1 and 2) read at the pinned block: worst deviation observed, time spent below each threshold.

params.name: mc_samples
params.why: Enough draws to stabilise the expected loss to the dollar; fixed seed → reproducible result.

params.name: mc_seed
params.why: Fixed seed so that two runs give exactly the same report.

params.name: usde_market_depeg.annual_rate
params.note: episodes of the Chainlink USDe/USD feed below $0.99 per year observed (src/risk/calibrate.py); if 0 episodes: rule of 3

params.name: usde_market_depeg.severity
params.why: Set from the on-chain history: worst Chainlink deviation observed ≈ 2.3% (21/02/2025).

params.name: usde_market_depeg.duration_hours
params.why: Set from the on-chain history: the longest stretch below $0.99 lasted ~7 min.

params.name: usde_severe_depeg.annual_rate
params.why: Never observed on-chain in ~2.5 years (the rule of 3 gives an upper bound of ~1.2/year): we take one major synthetic-dollar crisis every ~10 years.

params.name: usde_severe_depeg.severity
params.why: Beyond the history: from −5% (the position's liquidation threshold) to −30% (the framing note's demo scenario).

params.name: usde_severe_depeg.duration_hours
params.why: A confidence crisis lasts from a few hours to more than a week.

params.name: exchange_failure.annual_rate
params.why: Order of magnitude: one major exchange failure (FTX, 2022) in a few years among the large venues.

params.name: exchange_failure.severity
params.why: Share of the funds lost at the failed exchange (Ethena's exposure limited to unsettled PnL, see exchange_exposure_share).

params.name: exchange_failure.duration_hours
params.why: An exchange failure is settled in days, not hours.

params.name: exchange_failure.panic_depeg
params.why: Panic discount on USDe while the market works out the real exposure.

params.name: custodian_failure.annual_rate
params.why: OES custodians are regulated, segregated entities: failure deemed rarer than an exchange's.

params.name: custodian_failure.severity
params.why: Share of the assets frozen/lost at the failed custodian.

params.name: custodian_failure.duration_hours
params.why: Lasting shock (at least the horizon).

params.name: ethena_failure.annual_rate
params.why: Operational / contract failure of the issuer, order of magnitude.

params.name: ethena_failure.severity
params.why: USDe value loss if the issuer fails.

params.name: ethena_failure.duration_hours
params.why: Lasting shock.

params.name: pendle_exploit.annual_rate
params.why: Exploit of major DeFi contracts: low but non-zero annual order of magnitude.

params.name: pendle_exploit.severity
params.why: Value loss of the affected PT/SY.

params.name: pendle_exploit.duration_hours
params.why: Lasting shock.

params.name: morpho_exploit.annual_rate
params.why: Morpho Blue is an immutable, audited contract: probability deemed lower.

params.name: morpho_exploit.severity
params.why: Share of the collateral lost in the exploit.

params.name: morpho_exploit.duration_hours
params.why: Lasting shock.

params.name: chainlink_feed_fault.annual_rate
params.why: Outage / wrong price of a feed: rare, order of magnitude.

params.name: chainlink_feed_fault.severity
params.why: Gap between the reported price and the true price (downwards).

params.name: chainlink_feed_fault.duration_hours
params.why: Outage fixed within hours to days.

params.name: pool_liquidity_drain.annual_rate
params.why: Massive LP withdrawals during stress: more frequent than an exploit.

params.name: pool_liquidity_drain.severity
params.why: Share of the pool's liquidity that disappears.

params.name: pool_liquidity_drain.duration_hours
params.why: A few days.

params.name: usdc_depeg.annual_rate
params.why: USDC depeg (precedent: March 2023): rare.

params.name: usdc_depeg.severity
params.why: Size of a USDC depeg.

params.name: usdc_depeg.duration_hours
params.why: A few days.

confidence.p_star: medium to high: exit cost measured on-chain, loss computed on the proven graph; only the size/duration of the shock and a few transmission parameters are hypotheses
confidence.expected_loss_and_var: low: most annual frequencies are order-of-magnitude hypotheses (the DeFiLlama hacks dataset is paid) — see the sensitivity
